scenes.title: Dawn at the Gatehouse
scenes.rationale: Morning routines and the approach of one patrol form a continuous observation-and-preparation scene.
scenes.overview: The party wakes, spots the gnolls and their demon, and prepares an ambush.
scenes.transitionToNext: Wellby takes the shot at the flying demon, starting combat.

scenes.title: The Gatehouse Ambush
scenes.rationale: The ambush and defense of the gate form a continuous effort to draw the retreating gnolls back and prevent their leader from escaping.
scenes.overview: Wellby destroys the demon; Kenzo draws the gnolls back and holds the gate until it is forced open; Wellby kills the fleeing leader.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the leader dead, the fight centers on the remaining hunters and keeping Kenzo alive beneath the gatehouse.

scenes.title: Kenzo’s Last Stand
scenes.rationale: The remaining fight turns on defeating the hunters and supporting the badly wounded Kenzo in the passage beneath the gatehouse.
scenes.overview: The hunters fall, Kenzo becomes isolated and badly wounded, and his companions support him by rope until the remaining gnolls are defeated.
scenes.transitionToNext: The gatehouse fight ends and the party pursues its escaped gnoll.

scenes.title: Pursuit to the Outer Plaza
scenes.rationale: Containing the sleeping hyenas and chasing the survivor lead directly into a second fight near the stables.
scenes.overview: Seeker and Riswynn secure the hyenas; the party catches the fugitive and defeats four gnolls in the plaza.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the plaza quiet, the party splits up to scout and question the captive animals.

scenes.title: Captives and Corruption
scenes.rationale: The parallel searches, animal questioning, discussion of corruption, and rest share the immediate goal of understanding the cleared fort and deciding what to do next.
scenes.overview: The party finds starving animals, searches the buildings and leader, debates corruption, and rests before investigating the pools.
